summary:
BHIMA – Earth System Intelligence is an interactive web platform developed to explore and understand changes in Earth’s climate using NASA satellite observations.

Our solution addresses NASA’s Earth System Trend Detective challenge by allowing users to select geographic regions, explore historical precipitation data, visualize monthly time-series observations, and compare environmental patterns across different regions. Using pre-collected NASA GPM IMERG data covering up to 72 months for supported regions, BHIMA applies statistical techniques such as the Mann-Kendall test and Sen’s slope to identify trends, measure changes, and assess their statistical significance. Interactive maps and visualizations make these results easier to understand, while the Ask BHIMA Copilot helps users explore scientific insights through natural-language questions.

BHIMA transforms complex satellite datasets into accessible, meaningful information, helping people understand regional climate patterns and make better-informed decisions about our changing planet.
details:
BHIMA – Earth System Intelligence

BHIMA is an interactive Earth science investigation platform that transforms NASA satellite observations into meaningful environmental insights.

What does it do and how does it work?

BHIMA allows users to explore environmental changes across different geographic regions using historical NASA GPM IMERG precipitation observations. Users can select a region on an interactive map, investigate monthly observations, visualize time-series data, and compare environmental patterns across locations.

The platform uses pre-collected datasets covering up to 72 months for supported regions. Python-based statistical analysis, including the Mann-Kendall test and Sen’s slope, helps identify trends, quantify changes, and assess their statistical significance.

Benefits and intended impact

BHIMA makes complex Earth science data easier to access, explore, and understand. It helps students, researchers, educators, and the public investigate regional environmental patterns and understand how precipitation changes over time. Our goal is to encourage data-driven environmental awareness and support informed discussions about our changing planet.

Tools and Technologies

* Frontend: React, TypeScript, and interactive mapping.

* Backend: Python and FastAPI.

* Data: NASA GPM IMERG observations accessed through Microsoft Planetary Computer.

* Analysis: Python, time-series processing, Mann-Kendall testing, and Sen’s slope.

* Database and caching: SQLite and pre-collected regional observation datasets.

* Deployment: Vercel.

* AI development assistance: Google Gemini and AI-assisted coding tools.

What makes BHIMA creative?

Instead of presenting environmental data as static charts, BHIMA provides an interactive investigation experience. Users can select geographical areas, explore historical observations, compare regions, and examine statistical evidence behind detected trends. Its map-based exploration and scientific analysis bring satellite observations closer to everyday users.

Factors considered

We prioritized the use of real satellite observations, scientific reliability, regional coverage, statistical transparency, usability, and accessibility. We also designed the system around pre-collected datasets so users can investigate supported regions without repeatedly downloading large satellite datasets.
